On this day in 2023, Elon Musk officially announced xAI.

• May 26, 2024 — Raised $6 billion in Series B funding.

• Sep 2024 — Brought Colossus online with 100,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs, built from start to finish in only 122 days.

• Nov 4, 2024 — Opened the xAI API public beta.

• Dec 9, 2024 — Launched Aurora, xAI’s own autoregressive image-generation model.

• Dec 12, 2024 — Made Grok free for everyone on 𝕏 while adding web search, citations and multilingual improvements.

• Dec 23, 2024 — Raised another $6 billion through its Series C funding round.

• Jan–Feb 2025 — Launched standalone Grok applications for iOS and Android.

• Feb 2025 — Doubled Colossus to 200,000 GPUs just 92 days after completing the first 100,000-GPU cluster.

• Feb 19, 2025 — Unveiled Grok 3 and Grok 3 mini, trained with roughly 10× more compute, alongside Think and DeepSearch.

• Feb–Mar 2025 — Rolled out Voice Mode and the SuperGrok subscription.

• Mar 17, 2025 — Acquired AI video-generation startup Hotshot.

• Mar 28, 2025 — xAI acquired 𝕏 in an all-stock transaction, combining data, models, compute, distribution and talent.

• Apr–May 2025 — Released Grok 3 through the API and launched Live Search for real-time information from the web and 𝕏.

• Jul 9, 2025 — Launched Grok 4 and Grok 4 Heavy with native tool use, real-time search and reinforcement learning at unprecedented scale.

• Jul 12, 2025 — Brought Grok directly into Tesla vehicles through an over-the-air software update.

• Jul 14, 2025 — Launched xAI for Government.

• Jul–Aug 2025 — Introduced Grok Companions, launched Grok Imagine for rapid image and video generation with sound, and open-released Grok 2.

• Aug 28, 2025 — Launched Grok Code Fast 1 for fast and economical agentic coding.

• Sep 19, 2025 — Launched Grok 4 Fast, delivering Grok 4-class performance with significantly greater token and cost efficiency.

• Sep 25, 2025 — Expanded xAI for Government through the GSA OneGov program.

• Oct 27, 2025 — Launched Grokipedia, an AI-generated knowledge platform powered by Grok.

• Nov 17, 2025 — Launched Grok 4.1, which reached the #1 position on LMArena’s Text Arena during its rollout.

• Nov 19, 2025 — Launched Grok 4.1 Fast and the Agent Tools API while announcing a major partnership with Saudi Arabia and HUMAIN.

• Dec 2025 — Partnered with El Salvador on a nationwide AI education program; launched the Grok Voice Agent API, Collections API, Grok Business and Grok Enterprise; and was selected for a major U.S. defense AI program.

• By the end of 2025 — Colossus I and II had surpassed one million H100 GPU equivalents, while 𝕏 and Grok reached roughly 600 million monthly active users combined.

• Jan 6, 2026 — Raised $20 billion through an upsized Series E funding round.

• Jan 28, 2026 — Launched the Grok Imagine API for image creation, video generation and media editing.

• Feb 2, 2026 — SpaceX acquired xAI, combining artificial intelligence, rockets, satellites, communications and real-time information.

• Mar 10, 2026 — Launched Grok 4.20 and Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent, allowing multiple specialized agents to collaborate on difficult problems.

• Apr 17–30, 2026 — Launched standalone Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech APIs, Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 and Custom Voices.

• May 5, 2026 — Launched Grok 4.3 with a 1M-token context window, configurable reasoning and advanced tool-calling capabilities.

• May 6, 2026 — Launched Grok Connectors and Imagine Quality Mode while announcing a major Colossus computing partnership with Anthropic.

• May 15–21, 2026 — Brought Grok subscriptions to Hermes Agent, OpenClaw and OpenCode, then launched Grok Skills for persistent expertise, workflow automation and document generation.

• May 25, 2026 — Launched Grok Build, an agentic coding CLI capable of planning, searching, editing, testing and building software directly from the terminal.

• May 27–Jun 15, 2026 — Expanded the Grok coding ecosystem with Kilo Code, Grok Build through the API, Composer 2.5, plugins, a marketplace, an Agent Dashboard and Warp integration.

• Jun 3–18, 2026 — Launched Grok Imagine Video 1.5, expanded Grok Voice through Vapi, powered Gopuff’s Go and eToro’s Tori, and brought Grok to PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Amazon Bedrock and Databricks.

• Jul 1, 2026 — Launched Voice Agent Builder, a no-code platform for deploying production-ready Grok voice agents.

• Jul 6, 2026 — Launched 21 new flagship Grok voices.

• Jul 8, 2026 — Launched Grok 4.5, SpaceXAI’s smartest model yet for coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work—trained alongside Cursor, served at fast-model speeds and built for dramatically greater token efficiency.
